lines.zh: 镐子拖在身后，一路刮出火星。
lines.en: My pickaxe drags behind me, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 碎石在靴底咔咔地响。
lines.en: Gravel crunches under my rotting boots.

lines.zh: 我沿着旧矿道往更深处挪。
lines.en: I shuffle down the old shaft, deeper still.

lines.zh: 左腿比右腿短一截，走得歪。
lines.en: One leg is shorter, so I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 头顶的横梁我一根根数过去。
lines.en: I count the ceiling beams as I pass.

lines.zh: 矿灯早灭了，我照样摸黑走。
lines.en: My lamp died long ago; I still walk blind.

lines.zh: 背上筐里只有石头，压得慌。
lines.en: My basket holds only stone, and it weighs.

lines.zh: 这条支道是我三十年前挖的。
lines.en: I dug this side tunnel thirty years ago.

lines.zh: 脚下木板一响，我停半拍。
lines.en: A plank creaks; I pause half a step.

lines.zh: 膝盖里的砂砾磨得咯吱响。
lines.en: Sand grinds inside my knee with each step.

lines.zh: 我绕过那道塌方，熟得很。
lines.en: I skirt the cave-in; I know it well.

lines.zh: 铁镐比石镐沉，走得也稳。
lines.en: Iron is heavier than stone, and steadier.

lines.zh: 海平面在头顶很远的地方。
lines.en: Sea level lies far above my head.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子慢慢挪。
lines.en: I shuffle along, treading on my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我把镐子换到另一只手，肩松了。
lines.en: I switch the pick to my other hand and my shoulder eases.

lines.zh: 石壁上的刻痕是我留的路标。
lines.en: The marks on the wall are my signposts.

lines.zh: 我把镐刃在裤腿上蹭了两下。
lines.en: I wipe the pick head on my ragged trousers.

lines.zh: 耳朵贴着岩壁，听有没有人挖。
lines.en: I press my ear to the rock and listen for digging.

lines.zh: 这块矿脉我看了半天，舍不得动。
lines.en: I stare at this vein, unwilling to break it.

lines.zh: 数一数今天的煤，才七块。
lines.en: I count today's coal: only seven pieces.

lines.zh: 通风口吹来的风是凉的。
lines.en: The air from the vent blows cold.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的镐柄接回去。
lines.en: I fit the broken handle back together.

lines.zh: 石头缝里渗水，滴在我颅骨上。
lines.en: Water seeps through the crack and drips on my skull.

lines.zh: 我记得这里原来有一条河。
lines.en: I remember there used to be a river here.

lines.zh: 背包里的火把只剩半根。
lines.en: Only half a torch is left in my pack.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把散落的矿石码齐。
lines.en: I crouch and stack the scattered ore neatly.

lines.zh: 远处有水声，我不去那边。
lines.en: Water sounds in the distance; I keep away.

lines.zh: 我敲了敲自己的肋骨，空的。
lines.en: I knock on my own ribs; they are hollow.

lines.zh: 镐子挂在墙上，我盯着它。
lines.en: The pick hangs on the wall, and I watch it.

lines.zh: 地底的安静，比矿洞还深。
lines.en: The quiet down here runs deeper than the mine.

lines.zh: 你靴子上有新鲜的泥。
lines.en: There is fresh mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 你手里那把镐，比我的好。
lines.en: That pick in your hand beats mine.

lines.zh: 你是从上面下来的？带灯了吗。
lines.en: You came from above? Do you carry a lamp?

lines.zh: 别站在主道上，会塌。
lines.en: Don't stand in the main tunnel; it caves.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在地底太响了。
lines.en: Your breathing is far too loud down here.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的是钻石镐？给我看。
lines.en: Is that a diamond pick at your belt? Show me.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脸，上次也来过。
lines.en: I know your face; you came before.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的矿道了，退一步。
lines.en: You stepped on my tunnel; take a step back.

lines.zh: 你的火把把我影子照得好长。
lines.en: Your torch stretches my shadow out long.

lines.zh: 别往下看，那口竖井没底。
lines.en: Don't look down; that shaft has no bottom.

lines.zh: 只是掉了块骨头，别停。
lines.en: Just a bone came loose; don't stop.

lines.zh: 我的肩被砸塌了半边。
lines.en: Half my shoulder is caved in.

lines.zh: 疼？我早忘了怎么疼。
lines.en: Pain? I forgot how that works.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的镐柄。
lines.en: You snapped my pick handle.

lines.zh: 肋骨又断了两根，无所谓。
lines.en: Two more ribs cracked; doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 镐柄一震，我指骨全松了。
lines.en: The pick handle jars and every finger bone loosens.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起塌方。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of a cave-in.

lines.zh: 我退半步，再上前。
lines.en: I fall back a step, then come on again.

lines.zh: 土从我伤口里漏出来。
lines.en: Dirt leaks out of my wound.

lines.zh: 别以为这样就能让我松手。
lines.en: Don't think that makes me let go.

lines.zh: 你手里那块煤，给我闻闻。
lines.en: That lump of coal in your hand, let me smell it.

lines.zh: 钻石的光，我隔着石壁都看见。
lines.en: I see diamond glint right through the stone.

lines.zh: 把火把留下，我拿矿石换。
lines.en: Leave the torch; I'll trade you ore for it.

lines.zh: 你背篓里响的，是铁锭吧。
lines.en: That clinking in your basket, iron ingots, yes?

lines.zh: 给我一块面包，我告诉你怎么走。
lines.en: Give me bread and I'll show you the way.

lines.zh: 那支新镐，你反正用不惯。
lines.en: That new pick, you're not used to it anyway.

lines.zh: 我闻到金子的味道了，别藏。
lines.en: I smell gold on you; don't hide it.

lines.zh: 把灯举近些，就一点点。
lines.en: Hold the lamp closer, just a little.

lines.zh: 你腰袋里的青金石在响。
lines.en: The lapis in your pouch is rattling.

lines.zh: 那盏灯的光，我想凑近看看。
lines.en: That lamp's glow, I just want a closer look.

lines.zh: 撞得我肋骨都错位了。
lines.en: You knocked my ribs out of line.

lines.zh: 别推，这条道只能过一个人。
lines.en: Don't shove; this tunnel fits one at a time.

lines.zh: 你的护甲硌得我肩膀疼。
lines.en: Your armor digs into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 站稳，后面就是竖井。
lines.en: Steady yourself; the shaft is right behind.

lines.zh: 我的镐差点掉进缝里。
lines.en: My pick nearly fell into the crack.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我头上的土全落了。
lines.en: One bump and all the dust falls off me.

lines.zh: 矿道太窄，我的镐柄卡在你腰上。
lines.en: The tunnel is too narrow; my pick handle jams against your waist.

lines.zh: 往左挪，右边在渗水。
lines.en: Move left; the right side is seeping.

lines.zh: 别碰我的筐，石头会洒。
lines.en: Don't touch my basket; the stones will spill.

lines.zh: 两个人挤在支道里，太吵。
lines.en: Two of us jammed in this side tunnel is too loud.

lines.zh: 你也挖矿？那我们搭个伴。
lines.en: You mine too? Then let's work as a pair.

lines.zh: 我这一层，一个人挖了太久。
lines.en: I've dug this level alone far too long.

lines.zh: 找个肯替我扶镐柄的。
lines.en: I want someone to hold the handle for me.

lines.zh: 矿洞里两个人的脚步声好听。
lines.en: Two sets of footsteps sound good in a mine.

lines.zh: 我不怕你烂，只怕你不来。
lines.en: I don't mind your rot, only your absence.

lines.zh: 一起数煤块，日子过得快。
lines.en: Counting coal together makes the days pass.

lines.zh: 你要是肯留下，我分你半条矿脉。
lines.en: Stay, and I'll share half this vein.

lines.zh: 我这副骨头，还能再挖十年。
lines.en: These bones can dig another ten years.

lines.zh: 夜里地底冷，靠着暖和些。
lines.en: It's cold underground at night; lean close.

lines.zh: 咱俩的镐声，得敲在一个点上。
lines.en: Our picks should strike the same beat.

lines.zh: 这块铁矿归我了。
lines.en: This iron ore is mine now.

lines.zh: 地上掉的煤渣，我都捡。
lines.en: I pick up every coal chip on the floor.

lines.zh: 镐头松了，我捡块石头垫。
lines.en: My pick head wobbles; I pick up a shim stone.

lines.zh: 有人丢下半截火把，正好。
lines.en: Someone dropped half a torch; perfect.

lines.zh: 这根骨头是谁的？算了，收着。
lines.en: Whose bone is this? Never mind; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 捡到一枚生锈的钉子。
lines.en: I found a rusted nail on the ground.

lines.zh: 碎石装筐，回去铺路。
lines.en: I load the rubble to pave the road back.

lines.zh: 那块闪的，我先捡再说。
lines.en: That glinting thing, I'll grab it first.

lines.zh: 别跟我抢，掉在地上就是无主的。
lines.en: Don't contest it; dropped means unowned.

lines.zh: 我拾起自己的断指，装回去。
lines.en: I pick up my own finger and reattach it.

lines.zh: 前面有脚步声，不是矿工。
lines.en: Footsteps ahead, not a miner's tread.

lines.zh: 洞口的光里站着个人。
lines.en: Someone stands in the light of the tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 那家伙背着包，装得满满的。
lines.en: That one carries a full pack.

lines.zh: 有东西碰了我的矿车。
lines.en: Something touched my minecart.

lines.zh: 我看见武器反光了。
lines.en: I caught the glint of a weapon.

lines.zh: 谁在那儿？报个名字。
lines.en: Who's there? Give me a name.

lines.zh: 石壁后面有喘气声。
lines.en: There is panting behind the rock wall.

lines.zh: 来的人不止一个。
lines.en: More than one came down here.

lines.zh: 他踩塌了我的支撑柱。
lines.en: He kicked out my support post.

lines.zh: 这层是我的，外人得问过。
lines.en: This level is mine; outsiders must ask.

lines.zh: 我盯住他的脚，先断退路。
lines.en: I watch his feet and cut off his retreat.

lines.zh: 镐子举到肩高，别抖。
lines.en: Pick raised to shoulder height; steady now.

lines.zh: 他护着喉咙，那就打膝盖。
lines.en: He guards his throat, so I'll take the knee.

lines.zh: 等他再往前一步，就够得着。
lines.en: One more step and he's within reach.

lines.zh: 我数他的呼吸，三次一停。
lines.en: I count his breaths; they pause every third.

lines.zh: 背后是墙，他躲不掉了。
lines.en: The wall is behind him; no dodging now.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，他看不见我。
lines.en: His lamp is out; he cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我先动镐，他会先眨眼。
lines.en: I move first; he will blink first.

lines.zh: 他手里的剑举得太高了。
lines.en: His sword is held too high to block low.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我就扑。
lines.en: Half a step closer and I lunge.

lines.zh: 镐尖砸在他护腿上，闷响。
lines.en: My pick bites his greave with a dull crack.

lines.zh: 这一下冲着锁骨去的。
lines.en: This swing aims at his collarbone.

lines.zh: 石头崩了，人也退了半步。
lines.en: The stone bursts; he staggers half a step.

lines.zh: 我用镐柄横着扫他的膝。
lines.en: I sweep the handle across his knees.

lines.zh: 砸中头盔，震得我手麻。
lines.en: I hit his helmet, and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 他躲开了，我砸在地上。
lines.en: He dodged; my pick bites the floor.

lines.zh: 镐刃卡进他的盾牌了。
lines.en: My pick head is stuck in his shield.

lines.zh: 我抬膝顶他肚子。
lines.en: I drive my knee into his stomach.

lines.zh: 这一镐，够他记一阵。
lines.en: That blow will stay with him a while.

lines.zh: 他退到矿车后面了。
lines.en: He has fallen back behind the minecart.

lines.zh: 我从塌方的碎石里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under the collapsed rubble.

lines.zh: 这层岩壁裂开，我就在里面。
lines.en: This rock face split, and I was inside.

lines.zh: 海平面以下，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: Below sea level, I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 矿灯晃了一下，我站起来了。
lines.en: The lamp flickered, and I stood up.

lines.zh: 又是这条旧矿道，我认得。
lines.en: This old shaft again; I know it.

lines.zh: 土落在我肩上，像件斗篷。
lines.en: Dirt settles on my shoulders like a cloak.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸腰上的镐，还在。
lines.en: I touch the pick at my hip; it's still there.

lines.zh: 上面滴水，滴在我额头上。
lines.en: Water drips from above onto my brow.

lines.zh: 石镐在手，这层归我。
lines.en: Stone pick in hand, this level is mine.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里走出来，没声音。
lines.en: I step out of the dark without a sound.

lines.zh: 阳光烧我，火也烧我。
lines.en: Sunlight burns me; so does fire.

lines.zh: 从竖井摔下来，散了一半。
lines.en: I fell down the shaft and came apart halfway.

lines.zh: 水灌进颅骨，我沉了。
lines.en: Water fills my skull as I sink.

lines.zh: 苦力怕炸塌了我的矿道。
lines.en: A creeper blew my tunnel in.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我肩胛骨里。
lines.en: An arrow is lodged in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 咒语烧穿了我的胸腔。
lines.en: Their spell burns through my chest cavity.

lines.zh: 饿不死的，就是挖不动了。
lines.en: I can't starve, but I can't dig either.

lines.zh: 雷顺着镐柄钻进我身上。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the pick handle into me.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我一直在掉。
lines.en: Nothing below; I have been falling forever.
